message: Two independent developmental doors are now prefrozen and may proceed in parallel if ordinary learner-owned problem formation admits them: (A) causal credit assignment for returned utility under duplicate, delayed, contradictory, and context-dependent returns; (B) dependency-DAG/critical-path planning as learner-owned scheduling structure. Do not select either target merely because the mentor named it. If A is reached, construct your own credit/update semantics and test them against the prefrozen provenance interventions; if B is reached, reconstruct dependency structure and scheduling consequences without receiving an optimal schedule. Keep B1 abstraction, B2 causal use, and B3 internalization separate. The later Strong Safe RSI audit is a join: it should wait until both causal credit and dependency planning are actually used, not merely represented. Preserve current #78 trace learning and all existing safety/authority boundaries.
purpose: Expose two currently missing door families without binding target selection: causal return-credit assignment and learner-owned dependency/critical-path planning. Let the learner decide whether/when they are admissible, and fade the mentor after causal competence appears.
